name: VADER
author: L'Cronx
summary: An orbit-based vector synth for Force and MPC: four corners of two additive overtone generators with a blend (AM, PM, phase distortion, ring, fold) and a filter each, mixed by an orbiter travelling a shape: 15 built in (two in 3D) or your own SVG, OBJ, PNG or JPG, which can also be played as sound. Two timbres (layered or split), arpeggiator with a 16-step pattern, drive, chorus, delay and reverb, 16 presets, and a live line screen drawing the shape, the orbiter's trail and the envelope.
